title: Install Google Tag Manager across the Vite app
requirements: Add Google Tag Manager support to the React/Vite app and ensure the container loads on all public pages.
Make the GTM container id configurable through environment variables.
Preserve static prerendering and avoid blocking initial render.
Add verification coverage or a smoke-test path for the injected snippet.
notes: DONE (awaiting review). Implementation: (1) src/lib/gtm.js — SSR-safe, side-effect-free snippet builders (buildConsentDefaultSnippet, buildGtmHeadSnippet, buildGtmBodySnippet) plus env readers (getGtmContainerId, getGtmEnvTokens, getGtmEnvQuery). Reads VITE_* from import.meta.env (Vite) or process.env (Node scripts). (2) scripts/vite-plugin-gtm.mjs — Vite transformIndexHtml plugin that injects the GTM <head> snippet + <body> <noscript> fallback via string replacement (preserves exact markup). Registered in vite.config.js, which uses Vite loadEnv() to pass the resolved container id + DEV/STAGING env tokens explicitly (config module graph cannot see .env). (3) scripts/load-env.mjs — minimal .env loader so the plain-Node prerender/verify scripts see VITE_GTM_CONTAINER_ID. (4) scripts/prerender.mjs — loads .env, asserts the container snippet survived the client build, and fails the build if any prerendered page is missing it. (5) scripts/verify-gtm.mjs + `npm run verify:gtm` — smoke-test asserting loader present, container id embedded, noscript present, Consent Mode v2 default-denied emitted, loader async, and all prerendered pages carry the snippet; exits non-zero on failure. (6) eslint.config.js — added Node globals for config/scripts/gtm/tracking files. (7) README.md — documented installation + verification. Consent Mode v2 defaults (all signals denied) are emitted before the container loads. Container is a no-op when VITE_GTM_CONTAINER_ID is unset. Validation: `npm run build` succeeds and injects GTM-MQ858WZ3 (with DEV env tokens from .env) into dist/index.html; prerender reports 'GTM container GTM-MQ858WZ3 detected in build template'; `npm run verify:gtm` passes all 8 checks across 16/16 prerendered pages; production-style build (empty env tokens) correctly omits gtm_auth/gtm_preview; `npx eslint` clean on all new/changed files (full-project lint shows only the 12 pre-existing errors in untouched files).
